title: Lesson 37: Data Mapper Best Practices
description: Describe best practices for Data Mappers.

questions.question: Which is a Data Mapper best practice?
options: Respect FLS, parameterize inputs, shape outputs deliberately, test with sample JSON
questions.explanation: Best practices center on security, reuse, contracts, and testing.

questions.question: When should a Data Mapper be preferred over SOQL?
options: When field-level security or transformation is required
questions.explanation: Mappers respect FLS and transform data. The secure choice.

questions.question: How do you make an Extract reusable across callers?
questions.explanation: Parameterized inputs make mappers reusable artifacts.
